top_concerns: Accuracy-only evaluation on heavily imbalanced data; no CIs, F1 or majority/text-only baselines; GPT-4o gains of 1-2 points are likely within noise
Training labels come from Qwen2.5-VL-72B (same family as the base model); no human-vs-teacher or inter-annotator agreement reported; possible train/test leakage
Weak OOD evidence: +2 points over text-only Llama-Guard-3-8B on BeaverTails-V, big losses in many categories, odd 47.96% Qwen baseline on VLGuard, Llama-Guard-3-Vision missing from main tables
Category detection is poor (below GPT-4o in 9/13 categories), contradicting the claims of fine-grained classification and outperforming all baselines; no ablation showing the image is needed
Responses from weak 7B models under a jailbreak attack prompt are unrepresentative; incremental novelty; no ethics/release discussion
